QuestInfo.name: More than Truth
QuestInfo.0: #p2400005# and #p2400006# decided to take a stand. They would take down Will, and hopefully cure the corruption. #p2400000# cheered them on from the sidelines as they prepared to go to the Mirror World Control Room.
QuestInfo.1: #p2400005# and #p2400006# raced to the Mirror World Control Room, but Will was waiting for them. He told them that the Goddess would punish them for attempting to steal her powers... and then the Goddess moved.
QuestInfo.2: The Goddess attacked Will instead of #p2400005# and #p2400006#. The Goddess would never attack her own child, corrupted or not. Will was driven off... For now.
